owner_sample.rule: a label's rate max(percent / 100, min(1, floor / its vertices)); each count scaled by 1 / its owner's rate; a chunk count from the chunks' fill; chunk ranges cut at the sampled owners' byte shares; a family whose owners are all kept whole keeps its chunks
owner_sample.range_ends: chunks.<family>.first_id: the family's lowest owner, read whole (exact); chunks.<family>.last_chunk_value_bytes with last_chunk_bound: the bytes of the owners the last chunk can hold (from the highest id in its vid group down, while the chunker's estimates stay under the pack target), read whole, each encoded alone (an upper bound on the last chunk); a family kept whole: both its own
